name: Continuous Time Filter Design
description: Approximation theory for filters: maximally flat Butterworth approximation; equiripple passband Chebyshev approximation; equiripple stop-band inverse Chebyshev approximation; equiripple passband and stopband Cauer or elliptic approximation. Jacobi elliptic functions: analytical development, basic properties, double periodicity, addition of arguments, elliptic filter strategy, pass-band, transition-band and stop-band; Chebyshev rational function; construction of rational polynomial; elliptic filter transfer function. Synthesis of Butterworth and Chebyshev filters as doubly-terminated lossless prototype filters. Synthesis of inverse Chebyshev and elliptic filters as doubly-terminated lossless prototype filters. Low-pass to low-pass transformation. Transformation of prototype filters into active circuits: opamp-RC filter, switched-capacitor filter, gm-C filter. Richard's transformation and Kuroda's identities; transformation of prototype filter to microwave filter; stepped-impedance microwave filters.
